title: RECURSUM: Automated Code Generation for Recurrence Relations Exceeds Expert Optimization via LayeredCodegen
summary:
Automated code generation can systematically exceed expert hand-optimization for recurrence relations-computational primitives ubiquitous in orthogonal polynomials, special functions, numerical integration, and molecular integral evaluation. We present RECURSUM, a Python-based domain-specific language generating optimized C++ for arbitrary recurrence relations via three backends: template metaprogramming for compile-time evaluation, a novel LayeredCodegen backend with architectural optimizations, and runtime loop-based evaluation. The DSL uses einsum-inspired notation to specify recurrences, validity constraints, and base cases in 10-30 lines of Python, generating 650+ lines of production C++.
  LayeredCodegen achieves 9.8x speedup over expert hand-written implementations and 1.9x over template metaprogramming for McMurchie-Davidson Hermite coefficients. Architecture analysis reveals three quantifiable effects: (1) zero-copy output parameters eliminate return-by-value overhead (70-80% of speedup), (2) guaranteed function inlining eliminates compiler-refused overhead (15-20%), (3) exact-sized stack buffers achieve 100% cache efficiency vs 27% for MAX-sized arrays (5-10%).
  We validate on 24 recurrence types spanning pure mathematics (Legendre, Chebyshev, Hermite, Laguerre polynomials), numerical analysis (Clenshaw, Golub-Welsch), and quantum chemistry (McMurchie-Davidson, Rys quadrature, Boys function). Production benchmarks show speedups propagate to complete algorithms, with generated code matching expert baselines within 3.3%.
  RECURSUM demonstrates that systematic code generation serves as the performance ceiling for recurrence algorithms. By eliminating the dual expertise barrier (domain knowledge + C++ metaprogramming), the framework democratizes high-performance scientific computing-establishing a paradigm where automated generation systematically exceeds manual optimization.

AI.tldr: RECURSUM是一个基于Python的领域特定语言，用于通过三种后端（模板元编程、新颖的LayeredCodegen架构优化、运行时循环评估）为任意递推关系生成优化的C++代码，在多个科学计算领域实现显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 递推关系在正交多项式、特殊函数、数值积分和分子积分评估等科学计算领域普遍存在。传统的手动优化需要同时具备领域知识和C++元编程双重专业知识，这构成了性能优化的障碍。作者旨在通过系统化代码生成来超越专家手动优化，消除这一双重专业知识壁垒。
AI.method: RECURSUM使用受einsum启发的符号在10-30行Python代码中指定递推关系、有效性约束和基例，生成650多行生产级C++代码。系统提供三种后端：1）模板元编程用于编译时评估；2）新颖的LayeredCodegen后端进行架构优化；3）运行时循环评估。LayeredCodegen通过零拷贝输出参数、保证函数内联和精确大小的栈缓冲区等优化实现性能提升。
AI.result: 在24种递推类型（包括Legendre、Chebyshev、Hermite、Laguerre多项式、Clenshaw、Golub-Welsch、McMurchie-Davidson、Rys求积、Boys函数等）上验证。LayeredCodegen在McMurchie-Davidson Hermite系数计算上比专家手写实现快9.8倍，比模板元编程快1.9倍。架构分析显示三个量化效果：零拷贝输出参数消除返回值开销（占加速的70-80%）、保证函数内联消除编译器拒绝开销（15-20%）、精确大小栈缓冲区实现100%缓存效率（5-10%）。生产基准测试显示生成的代码与专家基线匹配在3.3%以内。
AI.conclusion: RECURSUM证明系统化代码生成是递推算法性能的上限。通过消除领域知识和C++元编程的双重专业知识壁垒，该框架民主化了高性能科学计算，建立了一个自动化生成系统化超越手动优化的新范式。
